summary.title: Hacker News
summary.one_liner: Hacker News is a link aggregator front page where tech and science stories are ranked by votes, with links to each story's comment thread.
keywords: stay up to date with tech news
where to find software engineering news
takeaways: The page is the Hacker News front page: a ranked list of submitted links, each showing points, author, age and comment count.
Navigation sections include new, past, comments, ask, show, jobs and submit.
Stories link to external sites (e.g. blogs, research, company pages), and each has a discussion thread.
Listed in a professional-programming resource as a way to keep up to date.
summary.summary: This is the front page snapshot of Hacker News, a news aggregator run by Y Combinator. It lists 30 submitted links with their point totals, submitter, time posted and comment counts, covering topics such as hardware, security, AI, science and programming. Each entry links to an external source and a separate discussion thread. The page itself contains no tutorial material; its value is as a regularly updated source of tech news.
